newsitem.title: CHINA: Tingyi proposes convertible bonds issue.
newsitem.headline: Tingyi proposes convertible bonds issue.

text.p: Tingyi (Cayman Islands) Holding Corp said on Monday it proposed to launch U.S. dollar denominated convertible bonds in international capital markets.
The instant noodle maker said it had appointed Deutsche Morgan Grenfell Hong Kong Ltd to lead manage the proposed issue.

"It is intended that the net proceeds of the issue of the bonds will be used by the company to finance its capital expenditure in relation to the company's instant noodle production lines in China and to reduce short-term indebtedness," Tingyi said in a statement.

The company said detailed pricing and other terms of the bonds, including the amount to be raised, conversion premium, interest rate, and the number of new shares to be issued, had not been determined and would be finalised by the end of July.
Application has been made to list the bonds in Luxembourg, it said.

The bonds will be offered to institutional and professional investors in Europe and Asia, and they will also be privately placed in the United States with institutional buyers and to professional investors in Hong Kong, it said.
Tingyi shares were unchanged at HK$2.00 each in early Monday morning.
